title: Nodes, Topics, Services, and Actions in ROS 2
description: Understanding the fundamental communication primitives—Nodes, Topics, Services, and Actions—is essential for building any robotic application with ROS 2. These components form the "nervous system" of a ROS 2 system, allowing different parts of a robot's software to interact seamlessly.
